items.summary: Hands-on course in building websites and web apps.
items.details: A practical course covering the foundations of the web and modern frontend work: semantic HTML, CSS layout, JavaScript, and building interfaces with React. It is where I went from tinkering to shipping complete projects.
highlights: Final project: a complete multi-page site

items.details: Engineering studies in polymer and textile materials. The habits carried over to software: working from first principles, measuring before changing things, and writing up how something works so others can follow it.
highlights: Engineering maths, materials science and process design
